title: Gelium Flow Contract
description: Machine-readable form of a flow: the ordered, URL-navigable sequence of screens that fulfils an intent for a user (ux-composition-model.md layer 4). Opaque identifier, not a resolvable URL. Worked example: docs/gelium/schemas/contracts/inbox-flow.json.

slug.description: Stable flow identifier. Screens reference it via flow_ref (e.g. 'inbox').

intent.description: The product-level goal the flow realises (Intent layer).

user.description: The actor pursuing the intent (User layer).

primary_task.description: The task the flow fulfils (Task layer).

entry_screen.description: Slug of the screen where the flow starts.

screens.description: Slugs of the screen contracts that compose the flow. Each must resolve to a screen-recipe instance.

contract.description: Navigation contract between screens (canonical set only, P5).

label.description: Control label on the source screen (action verb, R-CONTENT-01).

navigation.description: Ordered edges between screens with their canonical navigation contract.

success_state.description: The terminal navigable state that proves the intent is fulfilled.

failure_recovery.description: How a failure within the flow is surfaced and recovered (R-ERROR-01..04).

no_js_flow.description: The whole flow must be walkable with JS disabled (R-NOJS-01).

htmx_enhancement.description: HTMX enhancement across the flow; never changes mutation contracts (R-NOJS-03).
